title: fix(autocomplete): enhance focus and keyboard behavior
body:
**Summary**

This PR adjusts the behavior of the autocomplete widget when interacted with:

- refines with the input value if there is no active selection
- first <kbd>Escape</kbd> closes the panel, the second clears the selection
- first <kbd>Enter</kbd> closes the panel, the second blurs the input
- keeps focus on clear

FX-3579
